title: SG-4.1.2 Lock phaser to 3.90.x in package-lock.json
summary: Make package-lock.json resolve phaser to 3.90.0 in both lockfile entries
description: Context: game/frontend/package.json declares phaser ~3.90.0, but game/frontend/package-lock.json still records phaser ^4.2.1 in the root dependencies entry (L15) and version 4.2.1 under node_modules/phaser (L3445-L3453). Desired behavior: both entries use the resolved 3.90.0 release with its registry URL and integrity. Expected result: npm ci installs phaser 3.90.0. Why: the SG-4 Phaser 3.90 integration needs a reproducible install.
acceptance_criteria: Given package-lock.json, when packages[""].dependencies.phaser is read, then it equals ~3.90.0 and matches package.json
Given package-lock.json, when packages["node_modules/phaser"] is read, then version is 3.90.0 with the 3.90.0 tarball URL and integrity

in_scope: phaser root dependency entry in game/frontend/package-lock.json
preserve: all other lockfile entries, including eventemitter3 5.0.4

technical_constraints: Phaser must stay on the 3.90.x line
No network or Git credentials in the browser
definition_of_done: Both lockfile entries point to phaser 3.90.0
